title: Over a field, at a smooth point the dimension equals the rank of the differentials
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S$ a finitely generated $k$-algebra and $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] such that $k\to S$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Then $\Omega_{S/k}\otimes_S\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a finite-dimensional $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$-vector space and $\dim_{\kappa(\mathfrak q)}\Omega_{S/k}\otimes_S\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ equals the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}S$ at the point $\mathfrak q$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00TT (lemma-characterize-smooth-over-field, line 38609), implication (1) => (3); used in Smoothing 07CP (lines 1571-1576: 'the fibre ring of R -> D_k is smooth at q_k of dimension n')

proof.text: Finite type over the field implies finite presentation (Mathlib Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType). The smooth principal localization supplied by IsSmoothAtPrime puts q in Algebra.smoothLocus, by basicOpen_subset_smoothLocus_iff_smooth. Apply Algebra.IsSmoothAt.exists_notMem_isStandardSmooth to get f outside q and a standard smooth principal localization B = S_f. Extract its finite submersive presentation. Enumerate the relation variables first, via the equivalence from the domain of its injective map to its range, and enumerate the complementary variables second; reindex with these equivalences to obtain a presentation on Fin n and Fin c, with c <= n and map Fin.castLE.

Let K = kappa(q). The image of f in K is nonzero because the kernel of S -> K is q, hence is a unit. Extend the residue map to B by IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom, with its scalar-tower identity. The prime Q obtained by contracting the zero prime of K to B contracts further to q. The localization spectrum map is an open embedding. Prove local dimension invariance for an open embedding by pulling back open neighbourhoods for one inequality and taking open images for the other; the latter neighbourhoods are homeomorphic to the source neighbourhoods. Apply the existing standard smooth point-dimension theorem to the normalized presentation at Q, obtaining topologicalKrullDimAt q = n-c.

Localization S -> B is formally etale. KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale identifies B tensor_S Omega(S/k) with Omega(B/k); base-change its inverse along B -> K and use AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange to obtain a K-linear equivalence K tensor_B Omega(B/k) -> K tensor_S Omega(S/k). Base-change P.basisKaehler to K and map this basis along that equivalence.

The basis index is the complement of the range of the injective presentation map Fin c -> Fin n. Module.Finite.of_basis gives finite dimensionality; Module.finrank_eq_card_basis, Fintype.card_compl_set and Set.card_range_of_injective give finrank = n-c. Cast this natural-number equality to WithBot ENat and compare with the point dimension computed above.
